measuredCode: Uncommitted read-API candidate in isolated review worktree; not production.
supersededNote: The initial summary-after (180 samples) predates three alert-cursor queries. Final table uses the supplement run for this overlapping scenario.

sourceRuns.name: admin-read-benchmark.json
sourceRuns.boundary: Disposable 127.0.0.1 PostgreSQL with synthetic records only; no production URLs, users or financial writes.

modes.cold: Prisma connection disconnected before each measured HTTP request; database/OS cache is NOT flushed.
modes.warm: Same Prisma connection, one unmeasured warm-up before 30 requests.

metrics.httpMs: End-to-end localhost HTTP including auth and JSON serialization, no frontend render
metrics.sqlMs: Sum of Prisma query duration events (millisecond resolution)
metrics.rows: Response items; DOM/React measurements are separate browser QA
